subject: A pattern I noticed in your reviews — and an easy fix
body:
Hi Edgar,

I run a small studio that builds AI phone receptionists for home-service businesses, and I wanted to share something I noticed — not to criticize, just because it's costing you money and it's very fixable.

Looking at your reviews, a recurring theme is customers saying they couldn't get a callback. I want to be clear: that's almost never about how much a business cares — it's a coverage problem. When you and your techs are on jobs all day (which is exactly when a good HVAC company is busy), the phone goes unanswered, voicemails pile up, and a few callers fall through the cracks. The problem is, those are the customers who then leave the review — so a coverage gap ends up looking like a service problem on Google.

That's the exact thing I fix. We build an AI receptionist that answers every call 24/7 in a natural voice, captures the job and address, books the appointment, and flags real emergencies to you — so no caller ever hits a full voicemail again. It works alongside your team, not instead of it.

For an HVAC business, even one or two recovered jobs a month more than covers it — and it quietly stops the bad reviews at the source.

If it's useful, I'm happy to do a quick 10-minute call and show you how it'd work for your shop. No pressure either way.

Best,
Leo Lebel
cheddar.lebel@gmail.com
